title: Approval of Agreement No. 47049 for AI-Enabled Physical Security
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Office of the Chief Administrative Officer
  Approval of Agreement No. 47049 for AI-Enabled Physical Security
  Modernization and Integration with Convergint Technologies LLC.
  The proposed Agreement is for a term of three years and an amount not to
  exceed $103,000,000.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines
  Section 15060(c)(3).
